question: Can a fixed generic threshold-neuron substrate receive all task-specific Boolean circuit connectivity directly through programmed numerical weights, rather than gradient training or an associative-label slot table?
hypothesis: All 16 two-input and 256 three-input Boolean functions can be realized exactly as newly enabled sparse synaptic connections from input polarities into formerly disconnected AND gate sites and then to an OR output, when a complete truth table is supplied to the compiler. This proves bounded programmable logic, NOT novel operator invention, zero-information learning, or data/compute superiority.
changed_paths: optional explicitly identified PR-only qualification workflow and G29 generated artifacts; no authority files

inputs.name: complete 2-input Boolean truth tables, masks 0..15
inputs.source: deterministic grammar descriptor 'WSP10|2-bit|all-masks-0..15'; task specification itself reveals all 4 labels

inputs.name: complete 3-input Boolean truth tables, masks 0..255
inputs.source: deterministic grammar descriptor 'WSP10|3-bit|all-masks-0..255'; task specification itself reveals all 8 labels

frozen_design.split: No held-out split: compiler receives full truth table; all 4 or 8 contexts are in-spec, NOT unseen generalization.
frozen_design.ordering: n=2 then n=3; masks in ascending integer order; query patterns ascending; input bits least-significant first.
frozen_design.data_budget: 272 full truth-table specifications, equivalent to 2112 revealed binary labels; zero separately sampled outcomes, NOT zero information.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Deterministic one-pass compiler per mask; maximum 8 minterm gate sites, no iterative search, no gradient, no external API or model calls.
frozen_design.capacity: For n inputs: 2^n fixed empty n-input AND gate sites; 2*n signed/polarity input wires per gate and one gate-to-output wire, all task-specific wires initially 0. At n=3: 8*(2*3+1)=56 writable binary synapses. Input polarity inverter and AND/OR threshold operator types are fixed.
frozen_design.evaluator: For each mask and pattern x, compare threshold-net output with (mask>>x)&1, with separate exact symbolic lookup control. 2112/2112 is the engineering exactness criterion. Record active edge counts, snapshot integrity and failure controls.

controls: Independent symbolic truth-table lookup gets EXACTLY the same complete truth-table specification, 2112/2112 required.
All-zero crossbar weights (no task program): requires output=0 for every input and must fail on each positive target label, not be credited as learning.
Ablate one required gate-to-output connection for every nonzero mask: must flip at least the corresponding positive minterm to zero.
A predeclared one-hot table mask=2 at n=3, swap sensory bit 0 and 1 at evaluation: must expose a wrong prediction (identity mapping is not invariant).
Cold restores and corruption/tampering rejection for every world. No hidden labels, external worker, training-loop, pretrained feature model or paid model.

classification_rules.supported: ENGINEERING-ONLY if 2112/2112 numerical and symbolic outputs match, every nonzero-mask ablation detects change, all cold restores and tamper negatives pass, 0 gradient steps, all task-specific connectivity initially 0, and final exact-SHA dual-platform regression and source-integrity guards pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Correct circuit construction but incomplete mandatory negative, restore, or qualification; report each failing axis without scientific claims.
classification_rules.negative: Numerical circuit cannot represent one or more finite truth-table specifications within frozen 56-weight n=3 capacity, or primary exactness falls below 2112/2112.
classification_rules.invalid: Post-result threshold, masks, capacity, evaluator or code-source changes without independent requalification; missing prereg chronology; malformed inputs; untrusted evidence; inconsistent exact source.

scientific_limits: All target labels are supplied up front; equal-information exact symbolic compilation should tie. Zero gradient updates does not imply less total information, model autonomy, novel primitive invention, arbitrary reasoning, faster end-to-end execution or beneficial learning.
preregistration_note: Commit this file BEFORE any WSP-10 primary runner/test result. This is an isolated public synthetic development pilot, not scientific acceptance.
